statement: Weak pure infiniteness and Cuntz-algebra absorption. Resolves the ordinary-to-strong pure-infiniteness question of Kirchberg and Rørdam for complex C∗-algebras. For exact algebras, proper infiniteness of one fixed finite amplification of every positive element also suffices. Consequently, every separable nuclear algebra with this property absorbs $`\mathcal O_\infty`$, without unitality or simplicity assumptions.
